title: Voronoi-Based Vacuum Leakage Detection in Composite Manufacturing
summary: In this article, we investigate vacuum leakage detection problems in composite manufacturing. Our approach uses Voronoi diagrams, a well-known structure in discrete geometry. The Voronoi diagram of the vacuum connection positions partitions the component surface. We use this partition to narrow down potential leak locations to a small area, making an efficient manual search feasible. To further reduce the search area, we propose refined Voronoi diagrams.
